newsitem.title: UK: Sunderland, Man Utd up after league wins.
newsitem.headline: Sunderland, Man Utd up after league wins.

text.p: Shares in Sunderland Plc rose in early trading on Monday after the soccer club's victory on Saturday increased its chances of staying in the Premier league.
Manchester United Plc also rose after the club's win over Anfield gave it a clear run to retain the Premiership title.

Sunderland moved above the relegation zone with a 1-0 win over Middlesborough, while Manchester United's 3-1 victory over title challengers Liverpool at Anfield gave the club a five-point lead at the top with a game in hand over second-placed Arsenal.
Sunderland shares were up 20p at 515 by 0740 GMT in thin trde of 5,998 shares while United shares were up 8p at 654, also in thin trade of just 7,874 shares.
